   Number of plants = 44 plants

6. **Calculate the number of plants Pat needs to buy:**
   Pat already has 17 flowers, and she wants to fill the flower bed with 44 plants. So she need to add 44 - 17 = 27 more flowers.

7. **Calculate the total cost:**
   Total cost = Number of plants to buy * Cost per plant = 27 plants * $6/plant = $162

Therefore, Pat will spend $162 at the store to fill up her flower bed.
